description: This Java class 'RetryConfigurationAssembler' configures retry policies using resilience4j for different command execution scenarios within the Fineract project, including handling exceptions, exponential backoff, and persistence retries.

classes.name: RetryConfigurationAssembler
classes.description: Configures retry policies for command execution, batch processing, and persistence within the Fineract system, utilizing resilience4j and project-specific exception handling.

methods.name: isAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks if an object is an instance of any class in a list of exception classes.

methods.name: setLastException
methods.description: Stores the class of the last exception encountered in the request context.

methods.name: getLastException
methods.description: Retrieves the class of the last exception encountered from the request context.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForExecuteCommand
methods.description: Creates a Retry object for executing commands, with exception handling based on configured retry exceptions.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForBatchApiWithEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Retry object for batch API calls with transaction context, handling exceptions including BatchExecutionException.

methods.name: buildCommonExecuteCommandConfiguration
methods.description: Builds common retry configuration parameters such as max attempts and backoff strategy based on properties.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForCommandResultPersistence
methods.description: Creates a Retry object for command result persistence, excluding certain runtime exceptions.
